summary: A table of three domains where each row ends with an ExternalLink to a registrar URL.
use: Table cells that link out to a third-party site, with the external-link affordance.
spec: Header cells are Domain, Price and Registrar
`<ExternalLink href={r.url}>Buy at registrar</ExternalLink>` is rendered in each last cell
`{#each rows as r (r.domain)}` renders one `<tr>` per row
